scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n server,web,electron -c blue,green,magenta -k "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run start -w desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.package:mac: npm run build -w web && npm run package:mac -w desktop
